## FilePomelo - Free Online File Compressor | Images, PDF, Video &amp; Audio

URL: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/
Summary: FilePomelo offers completely free online file compression: images, PDF, video and audio are all compressed locally in your browser. No upload, no server, your files stay private.

100% Local · Files Never Uploaded Compress images, PDF, video and audio online 
 All compression, conversion and unzip happen in your browser — nothing is uploaded to any server. Batch processing, progress tracking and ZIP download included.
 Formats: JPG PNG GIF WebP AVIF SVG · PDF · MP4 MOV MKV FLV · MP3 OGG AAC WMA · ZIP · TTF OTF

 
 Drop files here
 or click to select · Ctrl+V to paste · choose a folder

 Supports images, PDF, video and audio. Mixed files are auto-detected and routed.

## Privacy Policy - FilePomelo

URL: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/privacy/
Summary: FilePomelo privacy policy: all files are processed locally in your browser and never uploaded to any server.

Privacy Policy
 Last updated: September 2026
 1. Files never leave your device
 All compression, conversion and extraction features of FilePomelo run locally in your browser (WebAssembly / WebCodecs / Canvas). File data is never sent to any server. Closing the page destroys everything instantly.

 2. What we collect
 This site has no accounts and does not collect file names, file contents or personal identity information. Basic aggregated usage stats (e.g. page views, referrers) may be kept to understand site usage.

 3. Cookies and tracking
 No advertising or tracking cookies, and no third-party ad or analytics scripts. If anonymous statistics (e.g. page views) are added later, only aggregated data will be collected.

 4. Third-party services
 The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). GitHub may record access logs (e.g. IP, User-Agent) under its own privacy policy; see GitHub’s official policy for details.

 5. Contact
 Questions about this policy? Reach us via the site footer or the GitHub repository (github.com/zhltzh/filepomelo).

100% 本地处理 · 文件不上传 在线压缩 图片、PDF、视频和音频 
 所有压缩、转换与解压均在浏览器内完成，文件不会上传到任何服务器。支持批量处理、进度展示与 ZIP 打包下载。
 支持格式：JPG PNG GIF WebP AVIF SVG · PDF · MP4 MOV MKV FLV · MP3 OGG AAC WMA · ZIP · TTF OTF

 无需注册，不限次数

 图片、PDF、视频、音频、ZIP 一站搞定

 隐私承诺
 所有处理都在你的浏览器本地完成，文件不会上传到任何服务器。压缩引擎按需加载并在本地缓存，二次使用无需重复下载。

## 隐私政策 - FilePomelo

URL: https://compress.aixuno.com/zh/privacy/
Summary: FilePomelo 隐私政策：所有文件均在浏览器本地处理，不会上传到任何服务器。

隐私政策
 最后更新：2026 年 9 月
 1. 文件不上传，处理全在本机
 FilePomelo 的所有压缩、转换与解压功能都在你的浏览器本地完成（WebAssembly / WebCodecs / Canvas），文件数据不会发送到任何服务器。关闭页面即完全销毁，不产生残留。

 2. 我们收集什么
 本站不设账号系统，不收集文件名、文件内容或个人身份信息。可能仅保留基础的访问统计（如页面浏览量、来源），用于了解站点使用情况。

 3. Cookie 与跟踪
 本站不使用广告追踪类 Cookie，不接入第三方广告或分析脚本。如后续接入匿名统计（如页面 PV），将仅收集聚合数据，不包含可识别个人身份的信息。

 4. 第三方服务
 站点托管于 GitHub Pages（GitHub 公司）。GitHub 可能按其隐私政策记录访问日志（如 IP、User-Agent），详情见 GitHub 官网隐私政策。

 5. 联系方式
 如对本隐私政策有任何疑问，可通过站点页脚或 GitHub 仓库（github.com/zhltzh/filepomelo）与我们联系。

---
